name: fdm_felix_food_common
machine_start_gcode:
; FELIX Food Single - Orca start gcode
{if bed_temperature_initial_layer[0]>0}M190 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer[0]}{endif}
{if nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]>0}M104 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]}{endif}
G28
G90
M82
M107
; Prime routine
G1 X10 Y10 Z10 F6000
M400
G92 E0
G1 E{2*retraction_length[0] + retract_restart_extra[0] + 0.5} F15
G92 E0
G1 X{20+nozzle_diameter[0]*2} Y10 Z{2*(1/4*nozzle_diameter[0])} F{initial_layer_travel_speed*60}
G1 X{40+nozzle_diameter[0]*2} Y10 E{nozzle_diameter[0]*initial_layer_print_height*20/((filament_diameter[0]/2)*(filament_diameter[0]/2)*3.14159265358979)} F{initial_layer_speed*60}
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
G92 E0
G1 E-{retraction_length[0]} F{machine_max_feedrate_e[0]*60}
G92 E0
G91
G1 Z10 F1200
G90
G28 X
G28 Y
M107
M84
